'''Tripton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held the position of [[Field Commander/Legends|Field Commander]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Tripton was among the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] sent to secure the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but he was driven insane by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy and spirits in the Temple, and was later [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tripton appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Dromund Kaas. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed by any Imperial character for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
